episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: After seven years in prison, a male stripper is unexpectedly granted a retrial. Released on parole, he hunts for proof that he was framed for murder.

translations.value: After seven years in prison, a male stripper is unexpectedly granted a retrial. Released on parole, he hunts for proof that he was framed for murder.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: Hugo finds a way to get a close look at the coroner's wrecked car. Triana follows a suspicious money trail to Melilla. Andrea makes an unlikely friend.

translations.value: Hugo finds a way to get a close look at the coroner's wrecked car. Triana follows a suspicious money trail to Melilla. Andrea makes an unlikely friend.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: When Andrea hints that his accident on the night of the murder was a coverup, Hugo searches in hospital records to see if Macarena's alibi checks out.

translations.value: When Andrea hints that his accident on the night of the murder was a coverup, Hugo searches in hospital records to see if Macarena's alibi checks out.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Hugo scrambles to hide the fact that he left Inferno at the time of the new murder. Andrea is approached by an old friend's mother, who makes a plea.

translations.value: Hugo scrambles to hide the fact that he left Inferno at the time of the new murder. Andrea is approached by an old friend's mother, who makes a plea.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Triana notices Philip's smartwatch is missing from police evidence, then realizes its data is likely on the cloud. Macarena learns more about Álvaro.

translations.value: Triana notices Philip's smartwatch is missing from police evidence, then realizes its data is likely on the cloud. Macarena learns more about Álvaro.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: An ID is made on the body found on the boat, but doubt leads Hugo to check its veracity. Macarena discovers Álvaro's mother knows her son's whereabouts.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: Under hypnosis, Hugo remembers key details of the night he was framed. Philip's smartwatch is found. Claudia must choose between her husband and Iván.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: Iván makes sudden travel plans. A new police commissioner takes Zapata by surprise. Andrea receives an unexpected gift from his Uncle Mateo.

translations.value: Iván makes sudden travel plans. A new police commissioner takes Zapata by surprise. Andrea receives an unexpected gift from his Uncle Mateo.

episodes.plot: Hugo steals from his captor evidence that leads him to the killer behind the charred body. Andrea calls Jairo for help. Óscar gets a tempting job offer.

episodes.plot: Andrea receives a threatening message. Macarena is directed to a safe containing a mysterious flash drive. Zapata forces Iván to do a favor for him.

episodes.name: Episodio 11
episodes.plot: Macarena is stunned by a betrayal. Triana gives the commissioner the evidence from the gas station. Jairo receives a lucrative offer.

episodes.name: Episodio 12
episodes.plot: Triana discovers Iván is hiding a secret about Inferno. When Andrea's flash drive is stolen from Jairo, the Inferno gang go undercover to get it back.

episodes.plot: The Irish mafia come looking for the money taken from their club. A video is leaked to the press. Hugo comes face-to-face with the rapist-murderer.

translations.overview: Dopo sette anni in un carcere di Malaga, uno spogliarellista rilasciato prima del nuovo processo vuole provare che l'amante l'ha incastrato per l'omicidio del marito.
After seven years in a Málaga prison, a male stripper is released pending retrial and sets out to prove his lover framed him for her husband's murder.
Libre tras siete años en prisión y pendiente de un nuevo juicio, un estríper decide demostrar que fue injustamente incriminado por el asesinato del marido de su amante.
translations.tagline: Imagina lo que más deseas: fiesta, sexo, dinero. Yo lo tenía todo

overview.value: Dopo sette anni in un carcere di Malaga, uno spogliarellista rilasciato prima del nuovo processo vuole provare che l'amante l'ha incastrato per l'omicidio del marito.
Mentre indaga sull'esplosione, Hugo affronta con gli amici un nuovo gruppo di avversari e un'inattesa serie di sfide sul lavoro.
